summary: Full backend + mobile UI smoke tested for TradeQuest. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passed against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (auth signup/login/me + invalid/duplicate, curriculum unlock logic, lesson content, lesson completion awarding XP/streak/badges + unlocking next lesson, progress+badges, leaderboard with seeded bots + is_me flag, stocks list, category filter, stock detail with quote/history/explain, 404s). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): auth screen renders with 'Continue with Google', email/password + 'Create an account' toggle; signup successfully navigates to the learning path tabs; winding lesson nodes render with a START pill above the current lesson; Explore tab shows category chips (All/Tech/Auto/Finance/Retail) and stock cards with prices and % change; tapping AAPL opens detail with $216.66 price, +4.16 (1.96%), 30-session chart, and explainer copy. Stocks are correctly served from simulated fallback (ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY empty).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping [data-testid=current-lesson-pill] did not navigate to the lesson player. The URL remained '/' after force-click. Users may expect the START pill itself to be tappable. Verify the pill's onPress handler / router.push is wired, or make the entire lesson-node the tappable surface.

issues: 'Invalid email or password' error color is red (#EF4444-ish) on dark bg — contrast is OK, but consider aria-live for accessibility.

react_native_issues.component: unknown (likely legacy Touchable in a dep)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' — non-blocking, likely from a lib.

action_items: Verify current-lesson-pill onPress navigates to /lesson/<id>. If the pill is decorative, ensure the underlying lesson-node (e.g. lesson-node-l1) is tappable and the pill doesn't intercept the press. Re-test by clicking either the pill or the node.

Optional: rename the bottom tab labeled 'Ranks' to 'Leaderboard' for consistency with the problem statement / testIDs (tests were written assuming 'Leaderboard'). This is a cosmetic mismatch, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_user() correctly excludes hashed_password and mongo _id — good.
seed_bots is idempotent via existing-email check — good.
av_quote falls back gracefully when ALPHA_KEY empty — expected behavior confirmed.
get_current_user rejects missing/invalid bearer with 401 — verified.
server.py is 500 lines — still within threshold but consider splitting auth/curriculum/stocks routers into separate files as content grows.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (auth+home+explore+stock detail verified; lesson-player interaction and leaderboard/profile tabs not fully drilled due to lesson-pill tap issue and tab label mismatch in selectors)

seed_data_creation: Signed up ephemeral test users (uuid emails). demo@tradequest.app / demo123 ensured to exist via login-or-signup fallback in test_login_demo_or_create.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bottom tab labels are Learn / Explore / Ranks / Profile (NOT 'Leaderboard'). Auth toggle text is 'Create an account' (not 'Sign up'). Stocks are SIMULATED (expected). To test the lesson flow end-to-end, try clicking [data-testid=lesson-node-l1] instead of [data-testid=current-lesson-pill] if pill is not tappable.
rca_of_issue: current-lesson-pill click didn't navigate: probably the pill is a purely decorative <View> without onPress, or it's overlaid on lesson-node-l1 but blocks propagation. Fix: attach the same onPress={() => router.push('/lesson/'+id)} to the pill OR wrap it inside the TouchableOpacity of lesson-node-l1 so bubbling reaches the parent.
